elements.label: Resilient
elements.description: Difficult to eliminate completely. [When this friendly unit is wounded, it does not die outright but instead enters a wounded state from which it can naturally recover.]

elements.label: Reinforced
elements.description: These soldiers have been reforged, possessing strength far exceeding others. [When a friendly unit gains this aspect, it clears any previously applied weakening effects and enhances its aspects. However, this aspect and its additional aspects will be lost upon departing the current region.]

elements.label: Lethal
elements.description: This one does not leave survivors. [This friendly unit will definitively eliminate any enemy that becomes its first target.]

elements.description: Not so different from my own men—just a bit more seasoned, and a bit better equipped.

elements.label: Ally Fighter Aircraft (Repairing)
elements.description: I have never seen aircraft this advanced—lightning-fast and staggeringly efficient.

elements.label: Ally Bomber
elements.description: They flew in wedge-shaped formations across the sky, leaving devastation in their wake. I have no doubt—they could pulverise entire cities.

elements.label: Ally bombersanno (Exhausted)
elements.description: They flew in wedge-shaped formations across the sky, leaving devastation in their wake. I have no doubt—they could pulverise entire cities.

elements.label: Allied Phlogiston-Wraith
elements.description: Released from its prison of glass and steel, this malignant spark now devours greedily all that it can touch. Such fierce burning cannot last long—but I do not think it cares.

elements.label: Allied Phlogiston-Wraith (Dead)

elements.description: [This friendly unit will repair itself over time.]

elements.label: Allied Bipedal Walker
elements.description: Menacing pipes deliver heat to the core. Sturdy metal binds the power within. They put a shell on a spirit loyal to the New King and call it a creation of technology. But their strength is indeed terrifying.

elements.label: Allied Bipedal Walker (Destroyed)
elements.description: Menacing pipes deliver heat to the core. Sturdy metal binds the power within. They put a shell on a spirit loyal to the New King and call it a creation of technology. But their strength is indeed terrifying.

elements.label: Allied Engine of Lights
elements.description: It looks like some kind of artillery fixture, though parts of its construction seem too complicated for its own good: cylinders of glass, coils of steel, tubes trembling with fire. But what firepower! Where this machine hits the mark, earth becomes glass and flesh becomes light. The King's toys are impressive, if nothing else.

elements.label: Allied Engine of Lights (Dead)
elements.description: It looks like some kind of artillery fixture, though parts of its construction seem too complicated for its own good: cylinders of glass, coils of steel, tubes trembling with fire. But what firepower! Where this machine hits the mark, earth becomes glass and flesh becomes light. The King's toys are impressive, if nothing else.

elements.label: 'Valkyrie' Bomber
elements.description: Soaring through the heavens like a Labhite, tearing the earth asunder like a saber-toothed beast, as indestructible as the spawn of Echidna. How does that ill-omened figure on the island manufacture such creations, and how does he command such terrible power?!
